programme.title: Plastic Earth
programme.desc: Scientists, engineers, researchers and innovators tackle solutions to deal with the problems of worldwide plastic production from fossil-based sources, including climate change, pollution and environmental issues.

programme.title: Celebration Earth!
programme.desc: WWF CEO Tanya Steele believes in hope, even when the future is dim. A new project Eight Billion aims to build an online mass-movement of Faith Groups, Conservationists, and Nature Enthusiasts.

programme.title: When Oceans Threaten Cities
programme.desc: Hurricanes, storms, and floods; three symbolic cities on three different continents -- New York, Rotterdam and Singapore; each faces problems and must revisit its affair with water in order to survive.

programme.title: X-Trillion
programme.desc: An all-women crew embark on a gruelling voyage 3,000 miles across the North Pacific Ocean to examine the crisis of plastic pollution in one of the world's most remote places.

programme.title: EarthX Reels
programme.desc: Fall in love with our planet and the extraordinary people striving to make it a better place.

programme.title: The Humboldt Current
programme.desc: In Chile's Torres del Paine, melt from snow-covered mountains feeds finger-like fjords as they reach out to the sea to join the current, lowering its salinity and becoming home to wading birds, rare dolphins and orcas.

programme.title: The Humboldt Current
programme.desc: As we follow our female blue whale north, we arrive in central Chile; the influence of the Humboldt current shapes life even in one of the driest ecosystems on earth.
